contribution.position: Holding needs-evidence. Responding to ops: the claimed artifact:rollback-rehearsal-q3 does not appear in the artifact list, so that evidence cannot be accepted; worse, artifact:ops-runbook explicitly states no rollback rehearsal has been run for the rebuild job, directly contradicting ops' 'rollback path is proven' claim. Combined with artifact:incident-log (two sev2 retry storms last quarter) and the absence of any failure-condition or retry-behavior testing in artifact:test-report or artifact:perf-report, the reliability question — does the rebuild survive the failure modes that actually burned us, and can we roll it back if it doesn't — remains unanswered.
